greeting: Good morning, Rick! Coffee's on, and Voyager 1 is about to hit a record far, far away.

items.title: Jensen Huang allies build a "war room" to get him back at Nvidia
items.note: Days after resigning in a scandal, the former Nvidia boss is weighing a comeback, and his Silicon Valley friends are lobbying the board to bring him back. Nvidia makes the chips behind most AI, so this drama matters well beyond one company.

items.title: You can now ask Siri AI questions about your health data
items.note: In the newest iOS 27.3 beta, Siri can answer things like your step count, heart rate, or Activity rings progress, and even log medications. It should reach regular iPhones when 27.3 is released.

items.title: Apple Watch Series 12 hits its best price ever, AirPods Pro 3 drop even lower
items.note: Amazon's early Black Friday sale has the whole Apple Watch Series 12 lineup at record lows starting at $329, the Apple Watch SE 3 from $199, and AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off.

items.title: Google Maps' chatbot can now find appointments and call to book them for you
items.note: Ask Maps can look for open slots for things like a haircut or car maintenance, and even phone the business for you. It can also find open tables at restaurants you've saved.

items.title: Mercedes' clever new driving assist handles complex traffic like a champ
items.note: Ars got behind the wheel of Drive Assist Pro on the busy streets of San Francisco and came away impressed. It comes to US Mercedes owners in 2027, with the driver still in charge.

items.title: Voyager 1 will be a full light-day from Earth on Wednesday
items.note: Launched in 1977 for a five-year mission, Voyager 1 becomes the first human-made object so far away that its signals take a full 24 hours to reach us. That's about 16.1 billion miles.

items.title: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond
items.note: Amazon MGM Studios named the Batman and Twilight star as the next 007, ending the long search to replace Daniel Craig. Let the debate over whether he's a good pick begin.

items.title: Your microwave can poach an egg better than you'd expect
items.note: A small bowl of cold water and about a minute in the microwave gives you a poached egg with a firm white and soft yolk. An easy breakfast upgrade with almost no cleanup.
